answers.reason: Students do not belong to the group that decides on university statutes, structure, and strategy in the senate.
Students are not mentioned as members of the group handling budget planning rounds.
Students are not part of the appointment committees that select candidates for professorships.
Students do not belong to the faculty council body that decides on faculty affairs and study regulations.
Examination boards decide on examination matters of individual students, but students do not sit in these bodies as decision-makers.
